title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of retro-reflective markings for vehicles of categories M, N and O
scope_summary: The regulation type-approves retro-reflective marking materials, such as strips, planes or graphics, that are used to mark vehicles. It covers materials intended for vehicles of categories M2, M3, N, O2, O3 and O4.
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to retro-reflective markings for vehicles of category M2, M3, N, O2, O3 and O4.
applies_to_components: retro-reflective strips (side, rear and/or front marking)
relation_to_other_regulations: Definitions in UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application apply to this Regulation (para 2.1.3).
The colour of reflected light is defined by reference to para 2.30 of UN Regulation No. 48.
Installation of contour/conspicuity markings on vehicles is governed by UN R48; R104 approves only the material.
Vehicle categories are as defined in Annex 7 to the Consolidated Resolution R.E.3 (TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.1/Amend.2, as amended by Amend.4).
Para 6 (General specifications) applies, by reference, the 'General specifications' sections of another text; the reference is truncated in the excerpt.

defined_terms.label: Sample unit
defined_terms.definition: Part or all of the retro-reflective material intended to be used to achieve the markings.

defined_terms.label: Distinctive markings, graphics
defined_terms.definition: Coloured markings whose coefficient of retro-reflection is as defined in paragraphs 7.2.1 and 7.2.2.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflection
defined_terms.definition: Reflection in which luminous flux is returned in directions close to the direction from which it came, maintained even over wide variations of the direction of the luminous flux.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflective marking material
defined_terms.definition: A surface or device from which, when directionally illuminated, a relatively large portion of the incident radiation is retro-reflected.

defined_terms.label: Reference centre
defined_terms.definition: A point on or near a retro-reflective area designated as the centre of the device for specifying its performance.

defined_terms.label: Reference axis (R)
defined_terms.definition: A designated line segment originating on the reference centre, used to describe the angular position of the retro-reflective device.

defined_terms.label: Entrance angle (β)
defined_terms.definition: The angle from the illumination axis to the reference axis, characterised by two components β1 and β2.

defined_terms.label: Observation angle (α)
defined_terms.definition: The angle between the illumination axis and the observation axis, always positive and small for retro-reflection.

defined_terms.label: Rotation angle (ε)
defined_terms.definition: The angle indicating the orientation of the retro-reflecting material with respect to rotation about the reference axis.

defined_terms.label: Coefficient of retro-reflection (R')
defined_terms.definition: The quotient of the coefficient of luminous intensity R of a plane retro-reflecting surface and its area A, expressed in cd·m-2·lx-1.

defined_terms.label: Luminance factor (β)
defined_terms.definition: The ratio of the luminance of the body to that of a perfect diffuser under identical illumination and observation conditions.

defined_terms.label: Colour of the reflected light of the device
defined_terms.definition: The colour of reflected light as defined in paragraph 2.30 of Regulation No. 48.

defined_terms.label: Type (of marking material)
defined_terms.definition: Marking materials differing in essential respects such as trade name or mark (with a different manufacturer), the characteristics of the retro-reflective material, or the parts affecting its properties.

classes_and_variants.name: Class C
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Retro-reflective marking material for side and rear (contour/line) marking with strips; white, yellow or red; may be adhesive (bonding strength test).

classes_and_variants.name: Class D
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Distinctive markings/graphics material with the lower coefficient of retro-reflection specified in para 7.2.

classes_and_variants.name: Class E
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Distinctive markings/graphics material with the higher coefficient of retro-reflection specified in para 7.2.

classes_and_variants.name: Class F
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Strip material for side, rear and/or front marking with its own dimensions, spectrophotometric colour measurement and flexing test; it is likely intended for flexible substrates such as curtains.

classes_and_variants.name: Colours
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: White, yellow or red for Class C; other colour rules apply to the other classes, per Annex 6.

classes_and_variants.name: Omnirotational vs non-omnirotational
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Non-omnirotational materials must bear a 'TOP' orientation mark at least every 0.5 m on strips, or within each 100 x 100 mm area.

applicability_hints: Conspicuity/contour marking tape on trucks, trailers and buses (M2, M3, N, O2-O4) is approved as material under R104; its fitting on the vehicle is governed by R48.
Retro-reflective company logos, advertising graphics or decorative markings on such vehicles fall under R104 as 'distinctive markings, graphics' (Classes D/E).
Retro-reflective strips on flexible substrates such as curtain-sided trailers fall under R104; Class F with its flexing test is likely the relevant class.
Category O1 trailers and M1 cars are outside the scope.
Rigid retro-reflectors (reflex reflector devices) are approved under other regulations (e.g. R3, now R150), not R104; R104 covers sheet/strip marking materials.
Rebranding an approved material under a different trade name by the same manufacturer requires only a declaration and two samples (para 3.1.4).
The same material produced by a different manufacturer under the same trade name is a different type requiring separate approval.
